item.title: QNotch 0.4.0
item.description:
## What's Changed * Integrate all open QNotch PRs for main by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/88 * Proposal: open from the physical notch area on macOS by @norbert-pap in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/59 * Proposal: expand the feature under the pointer on macOS by @norbert-pap in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/60 * Proposal: align macOS status content to consistent outer gutters by @norbert-pap in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/61 * Proposal: contain macOS search results without displacing the panel by @norbert-pap in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/62 * Proposal: make Search and feature visibility configurable on macOS by @norbert-pap in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/63 * Design review proposal: standardize macOS panel headers and layout by @norbert-pap in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/64 * Proposal: let users hide the macOS menu-bar icon by @norbert-pap in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/65 * fix(mac): align status clusters to consistent outer gutters by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/79 * Add native Mac Search feature enablement by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/80 * Fix Mac search containment and keyboard selection by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/81 * fix(mac): attach virtual notch to the menu-bar band by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/82 * Add persistent manual notification mute on macOS by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/83 * Separate Mac feature enablement from Home, tab and notch visibility by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/84 * Add independent Windows feature presentation controls by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/85 * Add manual notification mute on Windows by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/86 * Add an opt-in native macOS Terminal tab by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/87 * Improve Windows Features and Notifications settings layout by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/91 * Integrate all open PRs for Windows and macOS releases by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/97 * Add a default-off ConPTY Terminal on Windows by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/89 * Standardize macOS tab titles and page actions by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/92 * macOS: hide menu-bar icon with safe Settings recovery by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/93 * feat(macos): opt-in feature-aware hover destinations by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/94 * macOS: add Small Home widgets and drag resizing by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/95 * Windows: add Small Home widgets and edge resizing by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/96
## New Contributors * @norbert-pap made their first contribution in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/59
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/compare/macos-v0.3.0...macos-v0.4.0

item.title: QNotch 0.3.0
item.description:
## What's Changed * Mac diagnostics: outlines, snapshot mode, smoke checks, measure limits, debug channel by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/70 * Shared diagnostics: contract, Mac and Windows implementations by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/68 * Windows diagnostics: outlines, smoke test, measure, debug channel by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/69 * Open the Mac notch from the top row of the display by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/72 * Mac: fluid notch motion (springs by intent, flick, interruptible panel) by @Somafet in https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/pull/73
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Somafet/qnotch/compare/macos-v0.2.0...macos-v0.3.0
